releases.notes:
### Changes since Hana-TGP-V5

**New**

* **Work crosshair** — while the work switch is on, a small center-screen item icon shows current activity (idle campfire, print bricks, mine netherite pickaxe, fluid water bucket, fill sponge, cover obsidian, bedrock block). Vanilla crosshair is hidden while working and restored on work switch off / disconnect / quit
* **Minecraft 26.3 support** — full multi-version build target, including Quick Shulker and Chest Tracker deps for 26.3
* Added support for **26.1.1 / 26.1.2** and **26.3**

**Fixed / Improved**

* **Selection types** — Projection Selection applies to the whole schematic; Projection Render Layer is limited to the Litematica rendered area (print, mine, fill, fluid, cover)
* **Placement reliability** — fewer wrong / mis-state placements, faster recovery on laggy servers, player-level placement fixes
* **Manual Vanilla Refill** — more robust refill flow and extra tool refill options (netherite axe / shovel / hoe alongside pickaxe)

**Other**

* Default Settings - no need to replace file manually anymore, recommended defaults for 6b6t are included, make sure to try them first.
* README updated for new versions and work crosshair

releases.notes:
### Changes since Hana-TGP-V4

**New**

* **Manual Vanilla Refill** — when placement materials are missing, place a shulker from inventory above the player, take the needed blocks, then break and recover the shulker (no extra mods required)
* **Refill Shulkers from Ender Chest** — when no inventory shulker has the needed blocks, place 1 or 2 ender chests, pull a matching shulker from them, then continue normal refill
* **Refill Enchanted Golden Apples** — when the hotbar has fewer than 10 gapples, queue a shulker refill to bring the total up to 10 without interrupting an active refill
* **Refill Netherite Pickaxe** — when the inventory netherite pickaxe drops below 10% durability, queue a shulker swap with a usable pickaxe without interrupting an active refill
* **Drop Empty Shulkers** — while the work switch is on, automatically drop empty shulker boxes from the inventory
* Full English translation as the default language (config UI, tooltips, messages)

**Fixed / Improved**

* Manual Vanilla Refill only runs while the work switch is on; blocks the printer while a refill is in progress so placement does not fight the refill sequence
* Build system: `./gradlew :1.21.11:build` (and similar) only configures the requested version instead of every version
* Build system: all version JARs collected into a single output folder after build

**Other**

* Issue templates cleaned up / English-oriented
* Minor build and metadata cleanup

**Note:** The refill system is functional but still has a few small edge-case bugs left for a follow-up.

**Recommended Config:**
[litematica-printer.json](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32756454/litematica-printer.json)

**Preview:**

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/70717cc6-aa69-4ff6-a89e-0a630fccc8a0

releases.notes:
### Changes since 0.7.2.1-Hana-TGP-V3

**New**
* New selection types for all modes:
  * Below Player + Render Layer
  * Above Player + Render Layer
* Existing Below Player / Above Player now work on the full Litematica selection (no longer forced to intersect render layer)
* Previous “intersect with render layer” behavior is preserved via the new `*_LAYER` variants
* Available for both print and mine selection ranges

**Fixed**
* Above/Below selection for breaking (wrong/extra/wrong-state block breaking now correctly respects Above/Below and the new Layer variants)
* Standing-block Y calculation centralized
* PrintHandler selection-range checks made consistent with the shared selection predicate

**Other**
* Version bumped to Hana-TGP-V4
* Minor mod metadata cleanup (mod_id, archive base name, description)
